user: Is the deadline the same for every reason code?
answer:
No. Each reason code has its own window, counted in days from the transaction date. A dispute filed after the window closes is not eligible. From the knowledge base:

| Reason code | Window (days) |
|---|---|
| fraud_card_not_present | 120 |
| goods_not_received | 90 |
| service_not_rendered | 90 |
| duplicate_charge | 60 |
| unauthorized_debit | 56 |

For TX-0401 (dated 20 July 2026), goods_not_received has a 90-day window, so it runs until about 18 October 2026. The eligibility check I ran earlier confirmed the dispute is within its window. Because the window is counted from the transaction date, the sooner you file, the less risk there is of missing it.
